d:
U.S. President Donald Trump has left open the possibility of attacking Iran as early as October 25. But with a deal still on the table, will he choose military action or give diplomacy more time? With both sides holding firm, tensions remain high. A fresh U.S. attack could escalate the conflict, while a diplomatic breakthrough could ease pressure on one of the world’s most important oil and gas shipping routes.
Will Washington launch fresh strikes, or can the two sides find a way back to an agreement?
